Synopsis:
Massachusetts' Supreme Judicial Court unanimously issued a public reprimand to Judge Shelley Joseph, closing a years-long legal saga stemming from a 2018 incident in which she allegedly helped a Dominican migrant evade an ICE agent at her courthouse. Originally criminally charged in 2019 and later cleared in 2022, Joseph faced disciplinary proceedings that ultimately resulted in the lightest available sanction — a public reprimand — after the Judicial Conduct Commission failed to prove she knowingly facilitated the evasion. The reprimand was grounded in her off-the-record discussion with defense counsel and a comment suggesting she could jail the defendant without legal basis to shield him from federal custody.
